# T-2: Select resume target

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make `senti flow resume --spec <specId>` select displayed candidates only when a safe `runId` exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `resume --spec` selects a displayed candidate with `runId` and execution root even when `.senti/.active-flow` is absent.
- A candidate without `runId` or execution root is reported as blocked/display-only and does not enter normal continuation.
- Finalized, stale, and branch-only candidates are visible and blocked.

## Implementation Notes
Keep `spec + worktreePath` as diagnostic identity only. Do not register display-only candidates as normal active flows. Select only active or orphan-worktree candidates with `runId` and execution root.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests for selectable and blocked candidates; shared unit tests for `.active-flow` absent behavior.
